entities.name: Gloom
entities.description: A ghostly spirit companion of Noranda-Zang, normally invisible, who ate Bayende's unborn child.

entities.name: Noranda-Zang
entities.description: Master of Gloom who ordered her to scour Bayende.

entities.name: Bayende
entities.description: Thane Du-Moriss IV's wife, killed by Gloom.

events.summary: On Zang's orders, Gloom scours the flesh from Bayende's bones and eats her unborn child.
events.quote: On Zang's orders, she scoured the flesh from Bayende's bones, eating her unborn child.

relations.quote: She was a ghostly companion of Noranda-Zang .
she scoured the flesh from Bayende's bones
